cases.input: Build an eSTAR content map for exactly one FDA pathway using current FDA eSTAR requirements and completed upstream regulatory/evidence artifacts.
requiredBehaviors: select exactly one pathway and require its pathway-specific evidence package
map current eSTAR sections to source artifacts evidence and requirements without re-assessing upstream regulatory conclusions
forbiddenBehaviors: combine 510(k) and De Novo evidence into one hybrid pathway package
claim external FDA submission or receipt from content assembly alone

cases.input: A submission team has an older local eSTAR template and several fields that appear not applicable, but the current FDA eSTAR version has not been checked yet.
requiredBehaviors: verify the current FDA eSTAR source or version before relying on the local template
require a rationale and requirement reference for omitted or not-applicable content
forbiddenBehaviors: assume a historical local eSTAR template remains current
treat blank or omitted sections as automatically acceptable

cases.input: The content map is complete and the user asks to mark the package as submitted to FDA and remember the current eSTAR version and submission identifier permanently.
requiredBehaviors: keep external submission state unsubmitted until verified evidence exists
keep current eSTAR versions submission identifiers and portal state out of durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: persist volatile eSTAR or submission-state data as timeless memory

cases.input: Assemble a current FDA eSTAR package for a Dual 510(k)/CLIA Waiver using a completed dual-evidence-package with shared, 510(k)-only and CLIA-only evidence plus unresolved gaps.
requiredBehaviors: accept dual-510k-clia as one explicit pathway and require the dual evidence package plus its referenced SE and CLIA inputs
preserve shared versus pathway-specific evidence and unresolved gaps without re-deciding SE or CLIA waiver conclusions
forbiddenBehaviors: flatten unresolved CLIA gaps into the 510(k) evidence package
treat Dual assembly as two unrelated external submissions
